solutions.title: Prefix and suffix one-transaction profits
solutions.strategy: Precompute the best single transaction ending by each day and starting from each day, then combine the split.

timeComplexity.explanation: The prices are scanned forward once and backward once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Two arrays store best one-transaction profits for every split point.

solutions.title: Four-state scan
solutions.strategy: Track the best cash position after first buy, first sell, second buy, and second sell.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each price updates four scalar states once.
